results.title: The synergistic impacts of green finance and the digital economy on ...
results.content: # The synergistic impacts of green finance and the digital economy on urban low-carbon transition: Insights from 293 Chinese cities. Synergies between green finance and the digital economy enhance carbon mitigation. Spatial spillovers amplify low-carbon transitions across neighboring regions. The synergy shows heterogeneity for urban low-carbon transition. Provides targeted policies for green finance-digital economy synergy for sustainability. Green finance and the digital economy are now widely acknowledged as crucial catalysts for urban low-carbon transition. Leveraging panel data from 293 Chinese cities over the period 2014–2022, this paper explores how green finance and the digital economy affect urban low-carbon transition from a synergistic perspective. The results indicate that both factors play substantial roles in facilitating urban low-carbon transition and also exert a synergistic effect. Such synergy is achieved primarily through fostering green technology innovation, advancing industrial upgrading, and improving energy efficiency. Moreover, the synergistic effect generates positive spatial spillovers, promoting low-carbon transition in neighboring areas.
